label: Identity-Bearing Entity / Identity Subject Pattern
gate_b_rationale: Core must permit human and non-human subjects without assuming every subject is the same ontological kind; final UFO category is Gate-C work.

label: Digital Identity
merged_candidate_families: baseline; academic contextual identity; enterprise account evidence
gate_b_rationale: Retain as protocol-neutral digital representation linked to a subject and context; refine boundaries against Account/Profile/LegalIdentity.

label: Identifier
gate_b_rationale: Retain generic identifier with scheme/scope; DID and SPIFFE ID remain specializations/mappings.

label: Identity Context
merged_candidate_families: academic contextual identity; government jurisdiction; baseline
gate_b_rationale: Retain but do not overload with tenant, trust domain, administrative domain, audience or social context.

label: Identity Evidence
gate_b_rationale: Evidence is conceptually distinct from Claim, Credential and Proof and recurs in proofing, attestation and assurance.

label: Identity Proofing
gate_b_rationale: Needed to separate establishment of identity confidence from authentication of an already represented subject.

label: Evidence / Proof Pattern
gate_b_rationale: Admit neutral Evidence and Proof relation/pattern; cryptographic proof mechanisms remain profile-specific.

label: Claim
gate_b_rationale: Retain with ontology-level meaning as an assertion about a subject; protocol name/value members are mappings, not the definition.

label: Identity Attribute
gate_b_rationale: Retain but strengthen provenance/binding semantics and avoid treating social identity constructs as simple intrinsic attributes.

label: Attribute Provenance
gate_b_rationale: Source/derivation of identity information is cross-framework and necessary for trust and interoperability.

label: Attribute / Identity Binding
gate_b_rationale: Binding evidence/information to the represented subject is distinct from merely being about the subject.

label: Credential
gate_b_rationale: Retain broad credential concept with explicit categories; token/SVID/device credential remain profile specializations.

label: Credential Status
gate_b_rationale: Status is cross-ecosystem; concrete status-list mechanisms stay outside Core.

label: Credential Issuance
gate_b_rationale: Issuance recurs across credential paradigms and must be distinct from holding/presentation.

label: Credential Lifecycle Event
gate_b_rationale: Provide generic event/state pattern while keeping credential, account, session and participation lifecycles distinct.

label: Authentication
gate_b_rationale: Retain as event/process; must remain distinct from proofing, federation, session and authorization.

label: Authentication Result
gate_b_rationale: Retain result semantics independently from session establishment.

label: Authorization
gate_b_rationale: Retain and expand minimal semantics around request, resource, action, principal and decision without becoming a full access-control ontology.

label: Resource
gate_b_rationale: Authorization requires an explicit target resource.

label: Action
gate_b_rationale: Authorization evaluates a requested action over a resource.

label: Authorization Request
gate_b_rationale: Separates request information from the authorization evaluation event/result.

label: Authorization Context
gate_b_rationale: Environmental/request context must remain distinct from IdentityContext.

label: Authorization Decision / Result
gate_b_rationale: Refine current result to explicit decision semantics; no duplicate class is required if AuthorizationResult is redefined cleanly.

label: Principal
gate_b_rationale: Authorization targets principals that may be persons, accounts, groups or workloads; model as contextual role rather than entity kind.

label: Permission
gate_b_rationale: Minimal permission semantics support mapping of RBAC/scopes/policies without importing vendor role models.

label: Access Grant / Assignment
gate_b_rationale: Durable assignment of permission differs from runtime authorization decision and warrants a neutral relation/relator.

label: Delegation / actsOnBehalfOf
gate_b_rationale: Human and agent/workload scenarios independently require separation of actor from represented/authorizing subject.

label: Assurance Assessment
gate_b_rationale: Use generic assessment with dimension and level; do not collapse proofing, authentication and attribute assurance into one scale.

label: Trust Relation / Trust Assessment Hook
gate_b_rationale: Retain explicit trust semantics/alignment while separating interpersonal/social trust from institutional conformance and cryptographic validation.

label: Relying Party
gate_b_rationale: Retain the role but remodel as anti-rigid contextual role played by an organization/software/service, not a rigid kind.

label: Verifier Role Pattern
gate_b_rationale: Keep a generic verifying role only if specialized AuthenticationVerifier and CredentialPresentationVerifier semantics remain explicit.

label: Role-in-Interaction Pattern
gate_b_rationale: Systematically model interaction actors as contextual roles rather than rigid actor classes where ontologically appropriate.

label: Account
gate_b_rationale: A platform-local representation is distinct from subject and generic DigitalIdentity; profile-first avoids enterprise bias in Core.

label: User / Subject Profile
gate_b_rationale: Profile is a mutable information record linked to an account/subject and must not be equated with persona or subject.

label: Identity Source / Authoritative Source
gate_b_rationale: Operational identity source and source authority are recurrent but infrastructure-oriented.

label: Identity Store / Directory
gate_b_rationale: Directory is an infrastructure/service concept, not an identity-bearing subject.

label: Account / Identity Linking
gate_b_rationale: Needed for local/external identity co-reference while preserving source ownership distinctions.

label: Administrative Domain
gate_b_rationale: Tenant/realm/environment/pool boundaries are operational administrative constructs distinct from IdentityContext and TrustDomain.

label: Application / Client
gate_b_rationale: Application is a software participant that may play RP/client/resource-server/principal roles; vendor registrations remain mappings.

label: Federation
gate_b_rationale: Federation is cross-platform but paradigm-specific; represent in profile using Core roles/claims/trust rather than force into minimal Core.

label: Identity Intermediary / Broker
gate_b_rationale: Neutral mediator abstraction subsumes broker/orchestrator/exchange service roles.

label: Provisioning
gate_b_rationale: Provisioning manages account/profile representations and is distinct from enrollment, proofing and authentication.

label: Attribute Mapping
gate_b_rationale: First-class mapping artifact is required for cross-system interoperability, but it belongs to mapping/profile layer rather than minimal domain Core.

label: Group / Access-Group Membership
gate_b_rationale: Operational access group/membership is useful but must not be conflated with sociological GroupIdentity.

label: Session
gate_b_rationale: Important operational security context with independent lifecycle, but not universal across all identity paradigms.

label: Permission Bundle / IAM Role
gate_b_rationale: Map vendor roles/permission sets to PermissionBundle; never to UFO SocialRole solely by label.

label: Access Policy / Condition
gate_b_rationale: Detailed policy semantics remain profile-level; Core keeps references and authorization context only.

label: Issuer Role
gate_b_rationale: Use neutral contextual issuer role; avoid NIST-centric CSP as universal Core provider.

label: Holder Role
gate_b_rationale: Holder is distinct from subject, owner/controller and subscriber.

label: Credential Presentation
gate_b_rationale: Presentation is central to wallet/VC but not universal across paradigms.

label: Wallet / Holder Service
gate_b_rationale: Wallet and holder-service semantics are profile-specific software/provider roles.

label: Controller / Verification Method / Data Registry
gate_b_rationale: Keep DID/VC operational constructs in profile; generic Identifier/Credential/Evidence remain Core.

label: Selective Disclosure
gate_b_rationale: Privacy-preserving disclosure is important but profile-specific.

label: Trust Framework / Governance Framework
gate_b_rationale: Governed rule systems must be first-class in trust profile but are not equivalent to trust relations.

label: Trust Registry / Trusted List
gate_b_rationale: Registry/list communicates participant/service status and differs from TrustAnchor.

label: Trust Anchor / Trust Chain / Technical Trust Infrastructure
merged_candidate_families: STD-024/025; GOV-004; ACAD-013; NH trust bundle
gate_b_rationale: Cryptographic validation infrastructure is distinct from institutional governance and social trust.

label: Governance Authority / Registrar / Regulator / CAB
gate_b_rationale: Use neutral governance-role pattern with jurisdiction-specific specializations.

label: Certification / Accreditation / Ecosystem Participation
gate_b_rationale: Governance lifecycle/statuses are distinct from subject enrollment and credential lifecycle.

label: Legal Identity / PID / Government Attestation
gate_b_rationale: Essential to government profile but would make Core human/legal-centric if promoted globally.

label: Pseudonym
gate_b_rationale: Treat as Identifier specialization carrying context/linkability constraints rather than new Core primitive.

label: Workload / Runtime Entity
gate_b_rationale: Executing workload is an identity-bearing entity, not account, principal, identifier or credential.

label: Workload Identity / Service Account
gate_b_rationale: Represent with Core DigitalIdentity/Account/Principal patterns and profile specializations; do not create a single MachineIdentity superclass.

label: Device / Device Identity Record
gate_b_rationale: Device can be identity-bearing, but registry record, credential and authenticator remain distinct.

label: Attestation / Workload Attestation
gate_b_rationale: Specific attestation processes belong to profile while their evidence uses Core Evidence/Binding pattern.

label: Trust Domain / Trust Bundle
gate_b_rationale: SPIFFE-style namespace/security boundary is not IdentityContext or government TrustFramework.

label: AI Agent / Agent Identity
gate_b_rationale: Operational evidence warrants a profile view, but the domain is too immature for Core commitment.

label: Temporary Credential / Token Exchange
gate_b_rationale: Short-lived credential/exchange lifecycle is operationally important but generic Credential remains sufficient in Core.

label: Social Login
gate_b_rationale: Treat solely as OIDC/OAuth federation mapping through a social-platform IdP; not SocialIdentity.

label: Social Identity Family
gate_b_rationale: Social/group/role identity, persona, reputation, salience and related selfhood constructs form a separate research object.

label: Membership / Affiliation Social Semantics
gate_b_rationale: Link to external organizational/social ontology where needed; do not duplicate full membership/social-role semantics in CM4DI.

label: Identity Ecosystem / Paradigm
gate_b_rationale: Useful for analysis and profile selection but not a domain ontology entity required in Core.

label: Interoperability Requirement
gate_b_rationale: Keep as requirements/CQ/mapping/evaluation metadata rather than ontologize interoperability itself.

label: Transaction Log / Audit Record
gate_b_rationale: Useful for accountability/evaluation, but not needed in identity Core.

label: Privacy / User-Control Principle
gate_b_rationale: Preserve minimal sharing authorization hooks only; full consent/privacy ontology remains out of scope.

label: Identity Pool
gate_b_rationale: Pool has incompatible vendor meanings; map to AdministrativeDomain/Federation/Namespace rather than introduce lexical superclass.
